text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text:
What's up with this monster?!
It looks way stronger than the ones we've faced so far!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんですか、
この魔物！
今までの個体と全然迫力が違いますよっ！？

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: I guess the real battle starts here, huh?
text_block_list.orig_text: ついに真打ち登場って感じだね！

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text:
We must settle this once and for all.
For the sin of harming my love... You will pay with your life.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここで決着をつけさせてもらいます。
あのおかたを傷つけた罪……
死をもって……
償いなさい……
